title: The Barbie Dream Christmas Morning for Little Girls
description: Barbie Christmas gifts for little girls from Sam's Club: the Barbie Dream Camper, the Barbie Getaway Doll House, the Barbie Signature 2026 Holiday doll, the Barbie Ultimate Fashion Designer set, a Barbie hooded throw and a toddler holiday tutu set.
intro: There is a specific sound a little girl makes when she spots a pink camper under the tree, and it can break glass. This is the Christmas Eve setup for that moment: the Barbie Dream Camper parked by the Getaway Doll House, the 2026 Holiday Barbie in her red gown still in the box for the grown-up collector in the family, a fashion designer set for the kid who changes outfits nine times a day, a tie-dye hooded throw for watching the movie after, and a sparkly tutu set for the Christmas morning photos. Assembly instructions not included in my patience.

sections.heading: The big gifts
paragraphs: The Barbie Dream Camper playset with its roof tent and color-change grill, the Barbie Getaway Doll House with its doll and accessories, and the Barbie Signature 2026 Holiday fashion doll.

sections.heading: The extras she will actually use
paragraphs: The Barbie Ultimate Fashion Designer playset, the kids licensed 40 by 50 inch Barbie hooded throw with sherpa lining, and the Counting Daisies toddler girls holiday tutu set.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the tree and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, size and set contents before you buy.
